meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 里的对话可以选择由 OpenAI 的 Codex 来接管(替代 Claude)。Codex 负责规划、调用工具,支持 MCP 工具、服务端历史与会话恢复;登录凭据只存在 vault 里。
howto.when: 当用户把某个组的 provider 改为 codex(运行 ncl groups config update --provider codex),或把新组默认设为 codex 时,该组对话由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 请把这个组的 provider 切到 codex 并重启
say.note: 该组后续对话由 Codex 处理
需设置环境变量并重启,且需操作者确认
更新 ChatGPT 登录或 API key 到 vault

howto.what_en: As installed, NanoClaw's agent groups can be switched to use OpenAI's Codex instead of Claude. Codex handles planning and tool orchestration, supports MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume. Credentials live only in the vault.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a group's provider is set to codex (e.g. `ncl groups config update --provider codex`) or when new groups default to codex via environment; then that group's conversations are handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Please switch this group's provider to codex and restart it.
say_en.note: Subsequent chats in this group are handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Make new groups default to codex.
say_en.note: Requires an env change, restart, and operator approval.
Refreshes the ChatGPT login or API key in the vault.
